name: SmarToools RB40 AAA 1.5V 750 mWh Rechargeable Battery (2 Pcs Set)
description:
Product Specification

Model Number: RB40
Type: AAA Rechargeable Battery
Material: Lithium-ion
Quantity: 2 Pcs Battery

Charging & Power

Charging Method: Type-C USB Cable

Charging Voltage: 5V

Nominal Voltage: 1.5V

Typical Capacity: 400mAh

Energy Capacity: 750mWh

Charging Time: 2 hours (±0.5h)

Design & Dimensions

Diameter: Min 9.8mm, Max 10.5mm

Height: Min 43.5mm, Max 44.5mm

Weight: 6.9g (±0.5g)

Features

LED Indicators:

Blinks while charging

Stays on when fully charged

Safety Protection:

Short-circuit protection

Overflow protection

Overcharge protection

Over-discharge protection
